text: Swire Pacific owns approximately 43.09% of the total number of issued ordinary shares of Cathay Pacific Airways as at 31 December 2025.
short: Swire Pacific owns about 43.09% of Cathay Pacific

source.name: Cathay Pacific Airways Limited: Annual Report 2025 (Directors' Report, continuing connected transactions)
source.quote: Swire is the holding company of Swire Pacific which owns approximately 43.09% of the total number of issued ordinary shares of the Company as at 31st December 2025
source.note: Annual Report 2025 for the year ended 31 December 2025, published on 9 April 2026. Page 49 of the report.

additionalSources.name: Air China Limited: Interim Report 2025 (substantial shareholders, SFO register notes)
additionalSources.quote: Swire Pacific Limited’s approximately 44.98% equity interest in Cathay Pacific as at the end of the Reporting Period
additionalSources.note: Interim report for the six months ended 30 June 2025, authorised for issue on 28 August 2025 and filed on HKEX on 17 September 2025 (page 24, note 2 to the substantial shareholders section). Air China's 44.98% (30 June 2025) and Cathay's own 43.09% (31 December 2025) describe Swire Pacific's stake at different dates.
